TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() reads pricingRuleRequest through getPricingrule() and passes it to ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules. ABKOR001Impl.validatePostPricingRule validates effectiveDate.startDate and effectiveDate.endDate through PricingRuleValidator.validatePost, checks duplicate pricing rules with PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPost, and resolves each details value with PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues before persistence. 2. Decisions and branches: PricingRuleValidator.validatePost throws ABKO10000404 when !dateVal.isBlank(). PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPost returns without duplicate checks when details is null or empty. PostPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.validateVariableCandidates returns when no variable candidates exist; for each candidate it calls handleVariableExactMatch when conflictType is EXACT_MATCH and handlePaymentMethodOverlap when conflictType is PAYMENT_METHOD_OVERLAP. validateRegulatedCandidates returns when no variable payment methods or no regulated candidates exist, and handleRegulatedDuplicate only throws when the regulated candidate has the same fee. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() invokes ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules. ABKOR001Impl.executePostPricingRules calls validatePostPricingRule, gets the audit user with getUserId, and calls persistNewPricingRule. persistNewPricingRule gets audit and pricing rule sequence ids, inserts audit data with PricingRuleRepository.insertAudit, inserts the pricing rule with PricingRuleRepository.insertPricingRule using PricingRuleMapper.mapToInsert, and inserts each detail with PricingRuleRepository.insertDetails. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: PricingRuleValidator.validatePost throws ABKO10000404 when effectiveDate.endDate is before effectiveDate.startDate. UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPricingRuleAlreadyExists throws ABKO10010401 when handleVariableExactMatch or handleRegulatedDuplicate detects an existing candidate with the same detail set and the same fee. PostPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.handleVariableExactMatch throws ABKO10010402 when an exact variable duplicate exists but its fee differs. UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPaymentMethodOverlap throws ABKO10010415 when a variable candidate shares at least one payment method with the same non-payment-method details. PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues throws ABKO10010004 when no lookup query exists for details.entityType, when the resolved detail value is null or blank, or when the lookup raises NoResultException. ABKOR001Impl.executePostPricingRules catches PricingRuleException, adds the advice with addAdviceWithDescription(e.getCode(), e.getDescription()), returns null, and execute() then applies Severity.EWR through assignSeverityError when adviceList is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: when ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules completes, execute() calls setPricingrule(pricingRuleDTO) without a guard, so pricingRuleResponse is assigned even when the library returned null. On the success path persistNewPricingRule sets pricingRuleDTO.id to the generated prId after fillDetailValues has populated each details.value, and the same PricingRuleDTO is returned as pricingRuleResponse.
